name: Kenji Tanaka
psychographics: Believes performance is a discipline, not a hobby. Optimizes life like a system, but gets frustrated when tech gets in the way of gains.
current_solutions: WHOOP Strap 4.0 for recovery metrics; MyFitnessPal for macro tracking; buys premium protein from iHerb Japan.
frustration: At 8:17 PM on Tuesday, the WHOOP app crashed right before the sleep performance summary loaded, forcing him to manually input data into a spreadsheet just to hit his daily recovery target.
decision_style: Reads deep-dive reviews on Japanese fitness forums for three weeks before committing; will import niche supplements from the US if the data justifies the cost.
voice: Short, precise, switches between English and Japanese mid-sentence when stressed. Uses terms like 'recovery score' and 'macro split' without thinking.
